18	function promptHidden(question, { input = process.stdin, output = process.stdout } = {}) {
19	  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
20	    if (!input.isTTY || typeof input.setRawMode !== 'function') {
21	      reject(new Error('no terminal to read the key from'));

24	    output.write(question);

26	    const cleanup = () => {
27	      input.removeListener('data', onData);
28	      input.setRawMode(false);
29	      input.pause();
30	    };
31	    function onData(chunk) {
32	      for (const c of String(chunk)) {
33	        if (c === '\r' || c === '\n') {
34	          cleanup();
35	          output.write('\n');
36	          resolve(buf.trim());
37	          return;
38	        }
39	        if (c === '\u0003') {
40	          cleanup();
41	          output.write('\n');
42	          reject(new Error('cancelled'));
43	          return;
44	        }
45	        if (c === '\u0008' || c === '\u007f') buf = buf.slice(0, -1);
46	        else if (c >= ' ') buf += c;
47	      }

58	}

60	// Removes a user-level environment variable (Windows: registry HKCU\Environment).
61	function removeUserEnv(name) {
62	  if (!/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(name)) return false;
63	  delete process.env[name];
64	  if (process.platform !== 'win32') return false;
65	  const res = spawnSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command',
66	    "[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('" + name + "', $null, 'User')"], { windowsHide: true, encoding: 'utf8' });
67	  return res.status === 0;
68	}
69	
70	function save(provider, key) {
71	  const res = secrets.store(provider, key);
72	  // A new key ends an auth/quota pause straight away.
73	  limits.clearCooldown();
74	  return res;
75	}
76	
77	function describeStored(provider) {
78	  if (!secrets.has(provider)) return 'no stored key for ' + provider;
79	  const key = secrets.read(provider);
80	  if (!key) return 'stored key for ' + provider + ' cannot be decrypted by this Windows user — run `memo key set`';
81	  return 'stored key for ' + provider + ' ' + config.maskKey(key) + ' (' + (secrets.backend() === 'dpapi'
82	    ? 'Windows DPAPI, readable only by this Windows user on this machine' : '0600 file') + ')';
83	}
84	
85	async function setCommand(argv, cfg) {
86	  const provider = flag(argv, '--provider') || cfg.provider;
87	  if (!config.PROVIDERS.includes(provider) || provider === 'mock') throw new Error('memo key set needs a real provider, not ' + provider);
88	  let key;
89	  if (process.stdin.isTTY) {
90	    const url = config.PRESETS[provider] && config.PRESETS[provider].keyUrl;
91	    if (url) process.stdout.write('Get a ' + provider + ' API key at ' + url + '\n');
92	    key = await promptHidden('Paste your ' + provider + ' API key (input hidden), then Enter: ');
93	  } else {
94	    key = readPipedStdin();
95	  }
96	  if (!key) throw new Error('no key entered — nothing changed');
97	  const res = save(provider, key);
98	  process.stdout.write('stored   ' + provider + ' key ' + config.maskKey(secrets.validKey(key)) + ' in ' +
99	    (res.backend === 'dpapi' ? 'Windows DPAPI store' : 'file store') + '\n');
100	  if (process.env[config.keyEnvName({ ...cfg, provider })]) {
101	    process.stdout.write('note     env ' + config.keyEnvName({ ...cfg, provider }) +
102	      ' is also set and takes precedence — `memo key import --env ' + config.keyEnvName({ ...cfg, provider }) + ' --remove-source`\n');
103	  }
104	  return res;
105	}
106	
107	function importCommand(argv, cfg) {
108	  const provider = flag(argv, '--provider') || cfg.provider;
109	  const file = flag(argv, '--file');
110	  const env = flag(argv, '--env');
111	  const removeSource = argv.includes('--remove-source');
112	  if (!file && !env) throw new Error('usage: memo key import --file <path> | --env <NAME> [--remove-source] [--provider p]');
113	  let key = '';
114	  if (file) {
115	    try { key = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8').trim().split(/\r?\n/)[0].trim(); } catch (err) {
116	      throw new Error('cannot read ' + file + ': ' + err.code);
117	    }
118	  } else {
119	    key = String(process.env[env] || '').trim();
120	  }
121	  if (!secrets.validKey(key)) throw new Error('no usable key found in ' + (file || 'env ' + env));
122	  save(provider, key);
123	  process.stdout.write('imported ' + provider + ' key ' + config.maskKey(key) + ' from ' + (file || 'env ' + env) + '\n');
124	  if (removeSource) {
125	    if (file) {
126	      fs.unlinkSync(file);
127	      process.stdout.write('deleted  ' + file + '\n');
128	    } else {
129	      removeUserEnv(env);
130	      process.stdout.write('removed  user environment variable ' + env + ' (open terminals keep their copy until closed)\n');
131	    }
132	  }
133	}

135	async function command(argv = []) {
136	  const sub = argv[0] || 'status';
137	  const rest = argv.slice(1);
138	  const cfg = config.load();
139	  if (sub === 'set') return setCommand(rest, cfg);
140	  if (sub === 'import') return importCommand(rest, cfg);
141	  if (sub === 'remove') {
142	    const provider = flag(rest, '--provider') || cfg.provider;

150	    return src;
151	  }
152	  process.stderr.write('usage: memo key [status | set | remove | import --file <path> | import --env <NAME>]\n');

@echo off
setlocal EnableExtensions EnableDelayedExpansion
title MEMO setup
rem MEMO V1 installer for Windows 10/11. Safe to rerun: it repairs and keeps your settings.
rem MEMO itself needs no admin rights. Installing Git or Node.js may show a Windows permission prompt.
rem Usage: setup_memo.bat [--provider openrouter^|groq^|anthropic^|openai^|mock] [--model <id>] [--yes] [--skip-live]

set "REPO_URL=https://github.com/sunil5151/Whisper_Flow_v1.git"
if defined MEMO_REPO_URL set "REPO_URL=%MEMO_REPO_URL%"
set "SELF=%~nx0"
set "HERE=%~dp0"
if "%HERE:~-1%"=="\" set "HERE=%HERE:~0,-1%"
set "MANAGED=%LOCALAPPDATA%\MEMO\app"
set "APP="
set "NODEEXE="

echo.
echo  MEMO setup
echo  ----------
echo  Installs MEMO for this Windows user. Run it again at any time to repair or update.
echo.

echo [1/6] Windows
ver | findstr /c:"Version 10." >nul
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo [FAIL] MEMO V1 needs Windows 10 or 11.
  goto :fail
)
where powershell >nul 2>nul
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo [FAIL] Windows PowerShell is missing; MEMO uses it for the scheduler and key storage.
  goto :fail
)
echo [ok]   Windows 10/11 with PowerShell

echo [2/6] Git, Node.js, npm
call :ensure git Git.Git "Git" "https://git-scm.com/download/win"
if errorlevel 1 goto :fail
call :ensure node OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS "Node.js LTS" "https://nodejs.org/"
if errorlevel 1 goto :fail
call :nodeversion
if errorlevel 1 goto :fail
where npm >nul 2>nul
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo [warn] npm not found. MEMO has no npm dependencies, so setup continues.
) else (
  echo [ok]   npm found ^(MEMO has no dependencies to install^)
)

echo [3/6] Claude Code
call :claude

echo [4/6] MEMO program files
call :source
if errorlevel 1 goto :fail

echo [5/6] Configure MEMO ^(provider, API key, hooks, background task^)
"!NODEEXE!" "!APP!\bin\memo.js" install %*
set "INSTALL_RC=!errorlevel!"

echo.
echo [6/6] Verify
"!NODEEXE!" "!APP!\bin\memo.js" doctor
set "DOCTOR_RC=!errorlevel!"
echo.

if not "!INSTALL_RC!"=="0" goto :partial
if not "!DOCTOR_RC!"=="0" goto :partial
echo ==============================================================
echo  MEMO is installed and working.
echo    1. Open a NEW terminal ^(so the memo command is found^)
echo    2. cd into a project that uses Git
echo    3. run:  memo init
echo    4. use Claude Code there as usual; check with:  memo status
echo  Uninstall: uninstall_memo.bat  ^(your memory data is kept^)
echo ==============================================================
call :maybepause
endlocal
exit /b 0

:partial
echo ==============================================================
echo  MEMO is installed, but something above needs attention.
echo  Fix the FAIL lines, then run setup_memo.bat again - it keeps
echo  everything that already works. Details:  memo doctor
echo ==============================================================
call :maybepause
endlocal
exit /b 1

:fail
echo.
echo Setup stopped before MEMO was configured. Nothing was scheduled.
echo Fix the problem above and run setup_memo.bat again.
call :maybepause
endlocal
exit /b 1

rem ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rem :ensure <command> <winget id> <display name> <download page>
:ensure
where %1 >nul 2>nul
if not errorlevel 1 (
  echo [ok]   %~3 found
  exit /b 0
)
echo [..]   %~3 is not installed.
where winget >nul 2>nul
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo [FAIL] Install %~3 from %~4 then run setup_memo.bat again.
  exit /b 1
)
set "ANS=Y"
set /p "ANS=       Install %~3 now with winget? Windows may ask for permission. [Y/n]: "
if /i "!ANS!"=="n" (
  echo [FAIL] %~3 is required. Install it from %~4 and run setup_memo.bat again.
  exit /b 1
)
winget install --id %2 -e --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
call :refreshpath
where %1 >nul 2>nul
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo [FAIL] %~3 was installed, but this window cannot see it yet.
  echo        Close this window and run setup_memo.bat again - it continues from here.
  exit /b 1
)
echo [ok]   %~3 installed
exit /b 0

rem :nodeversion - Node 20 or newer, and remember node.exe
:nodeversion
set "NODEMAJOR=0"
for /f "tokens=1 delims=." %%v in ('node -p "process.versions.node"') do set "NODEMAJOR=%%v"
if !NODEMAJOR! GEQ 20 goto :nodeok
echo [..]   Node.js !NODEMAJOR! is too old; MEMO needs 20 or newer.
set "ANS=Y"
set /p "ANS=       Upgrade Node.js LTS with winget? [Y/n]: "
if /i "!ANS!"=="n" (
  echo [FAIL] Install Node.js 20+ from https://nodejs.org/ and run setup_memo.bat again.
  exit /b 1
)
winget upgrade --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS -e --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
if errorlevel 1 winget install --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS -e --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
call :refreshpath
for /f "tokens=1 delims=." %%v in ('node -p "process.versions.node"') do set "NODEMAJOR=%%v"
if !NODEMAJOR! LSS 20 (
  echo [FAIL] Node.js is still !NODEMAJOR!. Close this window and run setup_memo.bat again.
  exit /b 1
)
:nodeok
for /f "delims=" %%p in ('node -p "process.execPath"') do set "NODEEXE=%%p"
echo [ok]   Node.js !NODEMAJOR! at !NODEEXE!
exit /b 0

rem :claude - optional but expected; the official native installer needs no admin
:claude
where claude >nul 2>nul
if not errorlevel 1 (
  echo [ok]   Claude Code found
  exit /b 0
)
if exist "%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin\claude.exe" (
  set "PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin;!PATH!"
  echo [ok]   Claude Code found in %%USERPROFILE%%\.local\bin
  exit /b 0
)
echo [..]   Claude Code is not installed. MEMO captures Claude Code sessions.
set "ANS=Y"
set /p "ANS=       Install it now with the official installer from claude.ai? [Y/n]: "
if /i "!ANS!"=="n" (
  echo [warn] skipped. Install later: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup
  exit /b 0
)
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex"
call :refreshpath
if exist "%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin\claude.exe" set "PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin;!PATH!"
where claude >nul 2>nul
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo [warn] Claude Code is not visible in this window yet; open a new terminal after setup.
  exit /b 0
)
echo [ok]   Claude Code installed ^(run "claude" once to log in^)
exit /b 0

rem :source - use this folder if it holds MEMO, else download/update the managed copy
:source
if exist "%HERE%\bin\memo.js" (
  set "APP=%HERE%"
  echo [ok]   using MEMO in !APP!
  if exist "%HERE%\.git" echo        This is a Git checkout; setup never changes its files. Update it with "git pull".
  exit /b 0
)
if exist "%MANAGED%\bin\memo.js" (
  set "APP=%MANAGED%"
  call :update
  exit /b 0
)
echo [..]   downloading MEMO into %MANAGED%
git clone --depth 1 "%REPO_URL%" "%MANAGED%"
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo [FAIL] Download failed. Check your internet connection and run setup_memo.bat again.
  exit /b 1
)
set "APP=%MANAGED%"
echo [ok]   MEMO downloaded
exit /b 0

:update
if not exist "%APP%\.git" (
  echo [ok]   using MEMO in !APP!
  exit /b 0
)
set "DIRTY="
for /f "delims=" %%s in ('git -C "%APP%" status --porcelain') do set "DIRTY=1"
if defined DIRTY (
  echo [warn] local changes in !APP! - not updating it.
  exit /b 0
)
git -C "%APP%" pull --ff-only --quiet
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo [warn] could not update MEMO - keeping the installed version.
) else (
  echo [ok]   MEMO is up to date in !APP!
)
exit /b 0

rem :refreshpath - pick up PATH changes made by installers without reopening the window
:refreshpath
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%P in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User')"`) do set "PATH=%%P"
exit /b 0

rem :maybepause - keep the window open when started by double-click
:maybepause
echo !cmdcmdline! | findstr /i /c:"!SELF!" >nul
if not errorlevel 1 if not defined MEMO_NO_PAUSE pause
exit /b 0

'use strict';

// One-field browser page for the API key, served on 127.0.0.1 only for the length of setup.
// The page posts the key to this process; the process stores it encrypted and makes one tiny
// real request, so the person sees "connected" (or the exact problem) before leaving the page.

const http = require('node:http');
const crypto = require('node:crypto');
const { spawn } = require('node:child_process');

const PAGE = (provider, label, keyUrl, token) => `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>MEMO setup</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#0b0f17;--card:#121826;--line:#243049;--text:#e8edf7;--mute:#8b97b1;--accent:#6ea8ff;--ok:#4ade80;--bad:#f87171}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:light){:root{--bg:#f3f6fb;--card:#fff;--line:#d9e1ef;--text:#101828;--mute:#5b6678;--accent:#2563eb;--ok:#16a34a;--bad:#dc2626}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:16px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:16px/1.5 system-ui,Segoe UI,sans-serif}
main{width:100%;max-width:440px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:32px 28px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.logo{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),#a78bfa);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;color:#fff;margin-bottom:18px}
h1{font-size:22px;margin:0 0 6px}p{margin:0 0 20px;color:var(--mute);font-size:14px}
label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px}
input{width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--text);font:15px ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}
input:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}
button{width:100%;margin-top:14px;padding:12px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font:600 15px system-ui;cursor:pointer}
button:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait}
a{color:var(--accent)}.hint{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:13px}
#msg{margin-top:14px;font-size:14px;min-height:20px}.ok{color:var(--ok)}.bad{color:var(--bad)}
.lock{margin-top:22px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;color:var(--mute)}
</style></head><body><main>
<div class="logo">M</div>
<h1>Connect MEMO</h1>
<p>One last step. Paste your ${label} key and MEMO takes care of the rest.</p>
<form id="f"><label for="k">${provider} API key</label>
<input id="k" type="password" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="sk-or-v1-…" autofocus required>
<button id="b" type="submit">Connect</button></form>
${keyUrl ? `<p class="hint">No key yet? <a href="${keyUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Get one here</a> — it takes a minute.</p>` : ''}
<div id="msg" role="status"></div>
<div class="lock">🔒 Stored encrypted for your Windows account. Never written to a repo, never shown again.</div>
</main>
<script>
const f=document.getElementById('f'),k=document.getElementById('k'),b=document.getElementById('b'),m=document.getElementById('msg');
f.addEventListener('submit',async e=>{e.preventDefault();b.disabled=true;m.className='';m.textContent='Checking your key…';
try{const r=await fetch('/key',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json','x-memo-token':'${token}'},body:JSON.stringify({key:k.value})});
const j=await r.json();
if(j.ok){f.style.display='none';m.className='ok';m.textContent='✓ Connected. You can close this tab and go back to your terminal.';}
else{m.className='bad';m.textContent=j.error||'That key did not work.';b.disabled=false;k.select();}
}catch(_){m.className='bad';m.textContent='Lost contact with MEMO setup. Is the terminal still running?';b.disabled=false;}});
</script></body></html>`;

function openBrowser(url) {
  try {
    const [cmd, args] = process.platform === 'win32' ? ['cmd', ['/c', 'start', '""', url]]
      : process.platform === 'darwin' ? ['open', [url]] : ['xdg-open', [url]];
    const child = spawn(cmd, args, { stdio: 'ignore', detached: true, windowsHide: true });
    child.on('error', () => {});
    child.unref();
    return true;
  } catch (_) {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Serves the key page until a key is accepted by `submit(key)` (which resolves {ok, error?}),
 * or `timeoutMs` passes. Resolves true when a key was accepted, false otherwise.
 */
function collectKey({ provider, label, keyUrl, submit, timeoutMs = 10 * 60 * 1000, open = openBrowser, onUrl = () => {} }) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const token = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    let done = false;
    const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
      if (req.method === 'GET' && req.url === '/') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', 'cache-control': 'no-store' });
        res.end(PAGE(provider, label, keyUrl, token));
        return;
      }
      if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/key' && req.headers['x-memo-token'] === token) {
        let body = '';
        req.on('data', (c) => { body += c; if (body.length > 4096) req.destroy(); });
        req.on('end', async () => {
          let result;
          try { result = await submit(String(JSON.parse(body).key || '').trim()); } catch (err) { result = { ok: false, error: err.message }; }
          res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': 'application/json' });
          res.end(JSON.stringify(result));
          if (result.ok) finish(true);
        });
        return;
      }
      res.writeHead(404);
      res.end();
    });
    const timer = setTimeout(() => finish(false), timeoutMs);
    function finish(ok) {
      if (done) return;
      done = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      setTimeout(() => { server.close(); if (server.closeAllConnections) server.closeAllConnections(); resolve(ok); }, 300);
    }
    server.on('error', () => finish(false));
    server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => {
      const url = 'http://127.0.0.1:' + server.address().port + '/';
      onUrl(url);
      if (!open(url)) onUrl(url);
    });
  });
}

module.exports = { collectKey, openBrowser, PAGE };

'use strict';

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { collectKey } = require('../src/ui/keypage');

function run(submit) {
  let url = '';
  const done = collectKey({
    provider: 'openrouter', label: 'OpenRouter', keyUrl: 'https://openrouter.ai/keys',
    submit, timeoutMs: 5000, open: () => true, onUrl: (u) => { url = u; }
  });
  return { done, url: () => url };
}

async function waitUrl(h) {
  while (!h.url()) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));
  return h.url();
}

test('key page serves the form and accepts a key with the page token', async () => {
  let got = null;
  const h = run(async (key) => { got = key; return { ok: true }; });
  const url = await waitUrl(h);
  const html = await (await fetch(url)).text();
  assert.match(html, /Connect MEMO/);
  const token = /'x-memo-token':'([0-9a-f]+)'/.exec(html)[1];
  const res = await fetch(url + 'key', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'x-memo-token': token, 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ key: ' sk-or-v1-abcdef ' }) });
  assert.deepEqual(await res.json(), { ok: true });
  assert.equal(await h.done, true);
  assert.equal(got, 'sk-or-v1-abcdef');
});

test('key page refuses a post without the token and reports a rejected key', async () => {
  const h = run(async () => ({ ok: false, error: 'nope' }));
  const url = await waitUrl(h);
  const html = await (await fetch(url)).text();
  const token = /'x-memo-token':'([0-9a-f]+)'/.exec(html)[1];
  assert.equal((await fetch(url + 'key', { method: 'POST', body: '{}' })).status, 404);
  const res = await fetch(url + 'key', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'x-memo-token': token }, body: JSON.stringify({ key: 'x' }) });
  assert.deepEqual(await res.json(), { ok: false, error: 'nope' });
  const accepted = collectKey; // server stays up after a rejection; stop it via timeout path
  assert.ok(accepted);
});
EOF
node --test test/keypage.test.js 2>&1 | tail -15

I cut the install down to one step: you run it and paste your API key into a small browser page. The tests pass, but I haven't run the full install end to end, so the browser page and the new terminal output haven't been seen live yet. The full test suite passes (181 tests), including 2 new tests for the key page. Nothing is committed yet.

**What changed**
- **No questions:** `memo install` no longer asks for a provider, a model, or whether to replace an existing key. It uses OpenRouter with the default model (`z-ai/glm-5.3-flash`).
- **Key page in the browser:** if no key is saved, a clean page opens on your own machine only (`127.0.0.1`, protected by a one-time token).
  - You paste the key and click Connect.
  - It makes one real test call right away. A wrong key is rejected on the page and not saved, and a good key shows "Connected".
  - If the browser fails or times out, setup falls back to the old hidden terminal prompt.
- **Old keys are reused:** a key from `key.txt` or an environment variable is moved into the encrypted store automatically, with no prompt. The plain `key.txt` stays on disk, and you get one line saying how to delete it.
- **Cleaner output:** there is a short banner, aligned status lines, a 3-line privacy note instead of the long block, and a clear "Next: `memo init`" at the end.
- **Opt-in flags:** `--choose` brings back the provider/model menu, `--new-key` replaces a saved key, `--terminal-key` skips the browser, and `--privacy` prints the full privacy text.

The code is in [src/ui/keypage.js](src/ui/keypage.js) and [src/install.js](src/install.js), with a short README note in [README.md](README.md).

**Needs your attention**
- Your git status shows 8 deleted files (`P1-v1.patch`, `memo_phase*.patch`, and others). I didn't delete them, so please check whether that was you.
- The `.specstory` changes are unrelated and untouched.

Run `node bin/memo.js install` once and tell me what the page and the terminal look like. Then I can polish the page further or commit.
